newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAfrica stops Alpha, Blue Circle merger.
newsitem.headline: SAfrica stops Alpha, Blue Circle merger.

text.p: South African Trade and Industry Minister Alec Erwin announced on Wednesday that the proposed merger between cement companies Alpha Ltd and Blue Circle Cement would not be allowed.
Erwin's decision follows an announcement by the companies on March 3 that they would not go ahead with the proposed merger, following a Competition Board recommendation to that effect.

"After careful consideration of all the relevant points raised in the Competition Board's Report No 58 as well as consultation with relevant parties the Minister of Trade and Industry, Mr Alec Erwin has decided to accept the Board's recommendation that the proposed Blue Circle Cement merger with Alpha Ltd not be allowed," the Ministry said in a statement.
It said the matter had been discussed with the relevant parties who had agreed that the Minister's decision brought the matter to a close.
